# Self-regulated learning scores generated by a large language model

`srl` contains self-regulated learning scores derived from questionnaire
responses generated by a large language model (GPT). Each row represents
one of 300 synthetic respondents and contains five construct scores from
the Motivated Strategies for Learning Questionnaire. Scores are means of
the corresponding items, expressed on a scale from 1 to 7.

The dataset illustrates latent profile analysis with correlated
indicators. Strong associations among four constructs provide an example
for examining how assumptions about within-profile covariance influence
fitted solutions. Test anxiety shows a different pattern of association
with the remaining constructs.

## Usage

``` r
srl
```

## Format

A data frame with 300 rows and 5 columns:

- `cognitive_strategies`:

  cognitive strategy use

- `intrinsic_value`:

  intrinsic value of the course

- `self_efficacy`:

  self-efficacy

- `self_regulation`:

  self-regulation

- `test_anxiety`:

  test anxiety

## Source

The `SRL_GPT` data of the psychnets package, with descriptive column
names. Saqr, M. (2025). Delving into the psychology of machines:
Exploring the structure of self-regulated learning via LLM-generated
survey responses. *Computers in Human Behavior*, 173, 108769.
[doi:10.1016/j.chb.2025.108769](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chb.2025.108769)

## Details

Correlations among cognitive strategies, intrinsic value, self-efficacy
and self-regulation range from approximately 0.78 to 0.86. Their
correlations with test anxiety range from approximately -0.30 to -0.10.

## Examples

``` r
descriptives(srl, names(srl))
#>               variable   n n_missing     mean        sd      min      max
#> 1 cognitive_strategies 300         0 5.707179 0.5408047 4.153846 7.000000
#> 2      intrinsic_value 300         0 6.116296 0.5226347 4.222222 7.000000
#> 3        self_efficacy 300         0 5.926296 0.5870661 4.000000 7.000000
#> 4      self_regulation 300         0 5.544074 0.5000432 3.777778 6.777778
#> 5         test_anxiety 300         0 3.700000 0.6443088 2.000000 5.750000
#>   n_distinct
#> 1         34
#> 2         22
#> 3         25
#> 4         25
#> 5         16
```
